def transform(grid):
    split = next(i for i, value in enumerate(grid[0]) if value == 5)
    left = [row[:split] for row in grid]
    right = [row[split + 1:] for row in grid]
    collision = any(a != 0 and b != 0 for lrow, rrow in zip(left, right) for a, b in zip(lrow, rrow))
    if collision:
        return left
    return [[a if a else b for a, b in zip(lrow, rrow)] for lrow, rrow in zip(left, right)]
